source.title: ASME Boiler and Pressure Vessel Code, Section II - Materials, Part D - Properties (U.S. Customary)
source.note: Technical content only. Publisher front/back matter, running heads and printed folios are omitted. Values are as printed; the ASME ellipsis (no value / not permitted) is represented as null. NP = Not Permitted and SPT = Supports Only are kept verbatim where printed.

title: Tensile and Yield Strength Reduction Factor Due to Long Time Prior Elevated Temperature Service
notes: GENERAL NOTE: No reduction factor required for service below the indicated temperature. NOTES: (1) Tables E-100.1-3 and E-100.1-4 are selected to correspond to the maximum wall‐ averaged temperature achieved during any Level A, B, or C Service Loading. (2) See Table E-100.1-5.
